title: Part Sale tab is off by default and shows only the switch
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, Default 50% markup, Separate Part Sale pricing off.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for a customer on Default.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
  4. Point at the info icon beside the switch.
  5. Open Part Sale 1.
  6. Add a part with a cost of $100.00 in category A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The tab shows the "Separate Part Sale pricing" switch, off.
  • No grid and no Edit button show, while the switch and its info icon do.

Step 4:

  • The tooltip says Part Sales use the work order prices.

Step 5:

  • Part Sale 1 opens.

Step 6:

  • The part is priced by the Work Order Matrix: $100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00.
